The group is involved in the following organising activities:

* [The Response Diversity Network](https://responsediversitynetwork.github.io/RDN-website/){target="_blank"}
* [The Rigi Workshop 2026 - advancing mechanistic predictions of ecosystem service stability](https://responsediversitynetwork.github.io/RD-Workshop-2026/)
* [The European Chapter of the Ecological Forecasting Initiative](https://euro-ecoforecast.wordpress.com/){target="_blank"},
* [The World Biodiversity Forum](https://worldbiodiversityforum.org/){target="_blank"}.
* [MCSA Doctoral Network ReDiLEEP - Using science-driven response diversity knowledge to leverage efficient ecosystem preservation and restoration](http://redileep.eu/){target="_blank"}
* [PREDICT - Platform for REsilient Data Integration and Coordinated Forecasting Tools](https://oscars-project.eu/projects/predict-platform-resilient-data-integration-and-coordinated-forecasting-tools){target="_blank"}
